args.query: SEN-D1 door sensor pairing timeout procedure

results.text: Put the base station into pairing mode from the app (Add Device). Then hold the SYNC button on the camera or sensor for 3 seconds until its LED blinks blue. Keep the peripheral within 1 metre of the base station during pairing. Pairing times out after 120 seconds. After pairing, the device can be moved to its final location.
HB-100 owner could not add a new door sensor; app showed E-201. Base station already had 8 devices. Customer removed an old test sensor and pairing succeeded. Resolved at frontline.

Peripheral firmware is upgraded over the air (OTA) from the base station. Requirements: device within normal signal range, battery above 30 percent. CAM-S1 1.x upgrades to 2.1 (protocol v3). SEN-D1 1.0 upgrades to 1.3, SEN-M1 1.1 upgrades to 1.4. CAM-I2 hardware revision A with firmware 1.2 cannot be upgraded to protocol v3.

complaint: I'm replacing a broken door sensor. I removed the old one from the app, but the replacement just times out when I try to add it, and the app says pairing expired after two minutes. My brother is an electrician and says the new sensor is probably defective, so I'm thinking of returning it. Everything else in the system works.
usability_reason: The response is clear, polite, and actionable: it confirms the sensor is connected, instructs the customer to move it to its intended location and verify it stays online, and closes the case. It avoids unsupported claims—the pairing success was actually reported by the customer, and no unverified checks or fixes are asserted. The root-cause label is consistent with the observed pairing timeout but is not relied upon for credit.
